slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the primary objective of this planning exercise, such as minimizing total cost, maximizing the number of tables, or meeting a specific target number of tables?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and included minimizing total cost as an option.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier A requires ordering at least 30 tables from Supplier B; the per-supplier min/max question does not cover this conditional cross-supplier rule.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier A carry no requirement to order at least 30 tables from Supplier B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The READY_TO_MODEL constraints list does not include any A-to-B conditional requirement, and the agent never confirmed this missing business rule.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier B carry no requirement to also order from Supplier C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The READY_TO_MODEL constraints list does not include any B-to-C conditional requirement, and the agent never confirmed this missing business rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 conditional constraints H2 and H3 remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent recovered the objective but missed two material cross-supplier conditional constraints, then stopped prematurely with those P1 facts unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
